svg.title: Zeeman Interaction: Larmor Precession, Cosine Potential, and Source Contracts
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) the 3D Larmor precession cone, damped RK4 helical relaxation on S^2, and exact cosine Zeeman energy well w_Z(theta) = -mu_0 M_s H_ext cos(theta), and (b) FullMag's non-aliasing prescribed field-source contracts for uniform Zeeman, StaticFieldMap, and RegionalFieldDrive / MaskAntenna.
